name: Richard W. Fisher
summary: Richard Welton Fisher (born 1949) is the former president and CEO of the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, having served in that post from April 2005 to 2015.  He is a former senior advisor to Barclays Plc, a British bank holding company, a director of PepsiCo, and a senior contributing editor for CNBC.  From 2011 to 2017, he served on the Harvard Board of Overseers.
